stories.title: 'I don't let my AI talk to me like that'
stories.simple_summary: Someone wrote about not letting an AI program talk to them disrespectfully. They're setting boundaries with how AI communicates with them.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people who use chatbots regularly — it's a reminder that you can push back if an AI seems rude or unhelpful.

stories.title: Harburg: Students shouldn’t be AI’s beta testers
stories.simple_summary: A student or educator is saying schools shouldn't use students to test new AI tools before they're fully ready. Students would be the guinea pigs for unfinished products.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandchildren in school, this is worth paying attention to — it's about protecting students from experimental technology.

stories.title: ‘More than just objects’: Australian booksellers raise alarm over ‘horrific’ destruction of rare titles to feed AI
stories.simple_summary: Australian bookstores are upset because rare, valuable old books are being destroyed to train AI systems. They're calling this wasteful and harmful to history.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect you directly unless you own rare books, but it shows a real cost of AI training that many people don't think about.

stories.title: Judge denies xAI’s request to block Minnesota ban on ‘nudify’ apps
stories.simple_summary: A judge blocked a lawsuit that tried to stop Minnesota's new law banning apps that fake naked pictures of people. The ban can now go forward.
stories.why_it_matters: If you or anyone you know lives in Minnesota, this law protects people from having their photos used to create fake naked images without permission.

stories.title: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
stories.simple_summary: A popular YouTuber admitted he's using AI chatbots too much and it's become addictive, like getting a rush from a slot machine. He said it's not good for him or society.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an honest warning that AI tools can be habit-forming — worth knowing if you or someone you care about is spending a lot of time chatting with AI.

stories.title: Is this Billboard Hot 100 hit AI slop?
stories.simple_summary: A rap song that became popular on the music charts might have been created mostly by AI instead of by the artist himself. People are questioning whether it's real.
stories.why_it_matters: If you listen to music, be aware that some songs you hear might not be created by actual humans — the future of music is getting muddier.

stories.title: 'Enhance the lives of every Utahn': Cox launches $5M AI research funding program
stories.simple_summary: A company in Utah is giving $5 million to research AI and improve people's lives there. They're investing in AI development.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech workers in Utah — nothing you need to act on, but it shows money flowing into AI.

stories.title: Sam Altman is still making the case for parenting via ChatGPT
stories.simple_summary: The head of OpenAI is telling parents they can use ChatGPT to help with parenting questions. He thinks it's a good tool for moms and dads.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have young grandchildren and their parents use ChatGPT for parenting advice, know that it's one tool among many — not a replacement for experienced guidance.

stories.title: Prediction: The Historic Artificial Intelligence (AI) Infrastructure Build-Out Will Make This Stock a Multibagger
stories.simple_summary: An investment newsletter is predicting that a certain stock will become very valuable because of all the money being spent to build AI computer systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is investment advice aimed at stock traders — nothing you need to act on unless you actively trade stocks.

stories.title: This $9 key physically locks your most addictive apps
stories.simple_summary: Someone invented a $9 plastic key you physically touch to your phone to unlock apps you find addictive, like a child lock for grown-ups.
stories.why_it_matters: If you struggle with spending too much time on your phone, this is a simple tool that might help you take a break.

stories.title: The Dartmouth Workshop: The $7,500 investment that gave birth to AI (2/2)
stories.simple_summary: A story about a famous workshop from the past where scientists first came up with the idea of artificial intelligence, starting it all.
stories.why_it_matters: This is history — interesting background, but nothing that affects your daily life right now.

stories.title: Why many Connecticut school districts are turning to the same artificial intelligence platform
stories.simple_summary: Several schools in Connecticut are using the same AI computer program to help them with various tasks. Multiple districts chose the same tool.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in Connecticut with school-age grandchildren, your local schools may be using AI — worth asking your schools what they're doing and why.
